source: Meb Faber discusses the 200-day simple moving average as the starting point for the monthly timing model in https://mebfaber.com/2017/12/13/episode-86-quantitative-approach-tactical-asset-allocation/. The admission rule below is a local NFI experiment.
research_scope: The existing fixed 12/14 native Freqtrade wallets, 2025 independent year, 2026 to November 9 and 2026 November 10–25 restart, both 15 and 8 bp. The audit reuses closed and terminal native campaigns with independent reconciliation. It cannot measure the alternative wallet.
state: At 00:05 UTC each day, update from the preceding completed daily BTC/USDT:USDT futures close. Require 200 consecutive positive-volume calendar days ending on that close. Below or equal to their arithmetic mean means defensive. Use the preceding state for 00:00 UTC. Unknown prevents marginal long entries in the candidate policy.
policy: Keep the 14-slot account and its existing 12-slot custom stake basis. In the native entry confirmation callback, decline a fresh long if the native open-trade count is at least 12 and the BTC state is defensive or unknown. Shorts, up to 12 concurrent positions, existing positions, adds and exits keep the inherited rules.
audit: Match every native first fill to the successful entry confirmation sequence and check open counts before and after all fill timestamps. Within one bar the entry order is known and the ordering of same-bar exits relative to every entry may be unknown. Bound each entry's pre-confirmation count by treating all same-bar closes as preceding it, and by treating none as preceding it, capped at 13 for accepted fills in a 14-position account. Report definite and unresolved marginal longs with their recorded realized net PnL. Identify each account's maximum five-minute drawdown on the native marked NAV and measure both accounts on the same 14-slot drawdown interval, including BTC state, open trades and recorded trade-price gross notional per marked NAV at the trough.
native_account_requirement: Use no screening amount as performance. If the gate addresses observed marginal long losses, require a same-window continuous native 1,000 USDT, 3x isolated replay and independent reconciliation before any return claim. Compare with both fixed controls at the same cost and measure the change in large winning and losing trades.
